summary_en: recurmj proposed ERC-8103, a portable, revocable EIP-712 authorization struct for bounded pull transfers, with execution defined separately in ERC-8102. muhammadaus added command registries, nested encoding and packed multicall to the ERC-7730 clear signing format. tcoratger shared PrivacyEthereum's study of why users do not use privacy yet.
